blocks.text: This essential monthly and weekly planner for the 2026–2027 academic year features a clean, minimalist design with month-at-a-glance and week-at-a-glance spreads, including hourly scheduling from 7:00 AM to 8:30 PM. Printed on thick cream paper with durable frosted poly covers and Wire-O binding.

items: 2026-2027 Academic Year Monthly & Weekly Planner 2027 (14 Months - May 2026 through June 2027)
2 Page MONTH AT A GLANCE Spreads followed by 2 Page WEEK AT A GLANCE Spreads.

items.label: COLUMN FORMAT
items.value: Each Day offers Hourly Scheduling from 7:00 AM to 8:30 PM along with flex space for each day.

items.label: PROFESSIONAL DESIGN
items.value: Printed on cream (off-white) paper. Thick paper will prevent bleed through. Clear FROSTED Poly Protective front & back cover for extra durability. Strong Wire-O Binding for a professional look.

items.label: MINIMALIST DESIGN
items.value: Simple and clean format for efficient planning. Plenty of space for appointments, events and to-do items.
